name.en-US: The Adornment of the Spiritual Marriage

description.en-US: Ruusbroec's masterpiece on the active, interior and God-seeing life, in the English of C. A. Wynschenk Dom (1916) with Evelyn Underhill's introduction and notes. Its chapter division differs from David's Middle Dutch edition (book II has 67 chapters, not 77), so it is a separate edition of the same work.
description.pt-BR: A obra-prima de Ruusbroec sobre a vida ativa, interior e contemplativa, na tradução inglesa de C. A. Wynschenk Dom (1916), com introdução e notas de Evelyn Underhill.

sources.edition: John of Ruysbroeck, The Adornment of the Spiritual Marriage; The Sparkling Stone; The Book of Supreme Truth, translated from the Flemish by C. A. Wynschenk Dom, with an introduction and notes by Evelyn Underhill (London: J. M. Dent, 1916).
sources.description: OCR of the archive.org scan, rejoined across lines and pages by research/sourcing/_scripts/wyn_build.py; running heads removed; Underhill's endnotes placed as footnotes at the passage that cites them. Not proofread against the page images.
